enemies: Able to survive enemies up to level 86 attacking you

st.t: Talk to Almera on top of Baxtorian Falls, south of Barbarian Outpost.
Board the log raft west of Almera.
Talk to Hudon.
Use a rope on the rock to the south.
Use a rope on the dead tree.
Get in the barrel.
After the barrel washes you ashore, go into the large building to the north, where Hadley is, and go up the stairs.
Search the south east bookcase.
Read the book.

Walk through the Tree Gnome Village maze from its entrance on the north-west side. Letters are compass directions and numbers are tiles: E7, S2, E20, S6, W3, S1, W6, N4, W2, S6, W7, S2, E13, N2, E2, S2, E2, N2, E2, S2, E11, S3, E5, S9, W4, S6, E5, S3, W2, S11, W10, N5, E3, S2, E3, N2, E1, N5, W11. Go down the ladder there, at the entrance to the village.
Search the off-coloured crate in the east room.
Go through the gate in the west room.
Talk to Golrie.
Bank everything besides the pebble and some food. Then use Glarial's pebble on Glarial's Tombstone east of Baxtorian Falls.
Search the chest in the western room for Glarial's amulet.
Search Glarial's Tomb in the south room for Glarial's urn.
Leave Glarial's Tomb and get 6 air, water, and earth runes, a rope, glarial's amulet, glarial's urn, and some food.
Board the log raft west of Almera.
Use a rope on the rock to the south.
Use a rope on the dead tree.
Equip Glarial's amulet.
Enter the falls with Glarial's amulet equipped.
Search the crate in the east room for a key.
Enter the west room with the key.
Use 1 earth, water and air rune on each of the 6 pillars in the room. Afterwards, use Glarial's amulet on the statue of Glarial.
DO NOT TAP THE CHALICE, as taking the treasure washes you out of the cave! Use Glarial's urn on the Chalice to finish the quest.
